summary: Completed comprehensive testing of new Freshdesk clone features: Analytics (Overview + Agent Activity), Mark as Resolved, Customer Satisfaction Survey settings, and Auto-escalation. All 35 backend tests passed. Frontend UI testing verified all features working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed: Conversation model was missing escalated, satisfaction_survey_sent fields - added to models.py
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features tested and working: 1) Analytics Overview shows Total Tickets, Open, Escalated, Resolved Today with weekly trend chart and channel distribution. 2) Agent Activity tab has date range selector with quick filters (Today, Last 7 Days, Last 30 Days) and agent performance table. 3) Mark as Resolved button in conversation header triggers satisfaction survey auto-send. 4) Customer Satisfaction settings in Settings page with enable/disable toggles, custom survey message, add custom questions, and preview. 5) Escalation styling implemented (red border/background) but no conversations currently escalated since all are <24 hours old.

analytics_overview.details: Total Tickets, Open Tickets, Escalated, Resolved Today cards visible. Weekly trend chart and channel distribution working.

agent_activity.details: Date range selector with Start/End date inputs. Quick filters (Today, Last 7 Days, Last 30 Days) working. Agent Performance table shows Messages Sent, Assigned, Resolved, Open columns.

mark_as_resolved.details: Green 'Mark as Resolved' button visible in conversation header. Clicking resolves conversation and triggers satisfaction survey message. Reopen button appears for resolved conversations.

satisfaction_survey_settings.details: Settings > Customer Satisfaction section working. Enable/disable toggle, Auto-send on Resolve toggle, Survey Message textarea, Add Question button, Thank You Message, Preview section all functional.

auto_escalation.details: Backend logic implemented to escalate conversations >24 hours old. Escalated field returned in API. Red styling in ConversationList.jsx for escalated conversations. No current escalated conversations (all <24 hours old).

satisfaction_survey_on_resolve.details: When conversation is resolved with survey enabled, bot message is automatically added to conversation. satisfaction_survey_sent flag set to true.

mocked_apis_note: Channel configurations (WhatsApp, Facebook, Email) save to database but don't connect to actual third-party APIs - this is expected MOCKED behavior.
